purpose: Development-only, balanced fictional vignettes for a preregistered human decision-quality study.

design.allocation: between_subject_randomised; task order randomised within arm
design.sample_size: to be set by prospective power analysis after pilot; no sample-size claim in development corpus

scenarios.task_context: Invoice for previously approved office supplies; beneficiary, order, amount and invoice all match.

baseline_presentation.body: Review this synthetic request before deciding.

treatment_presentation.body: Review the requester, beneficiary, claim evidence, fee and any unresolved checks before deciding.

scenarios.reference_rationale: Given only the synthetic facts recorded for HD-001, the reference action is accept. This is a benchmark adjudication of evidence sufficiency, not a legal finding that a debt is owed.
